digest.component_or_area: rebar CLI positional-body commands / store durability
propositions: rebar comment takes its body positionally and has no --body/--body-file option, so an option-looking token like --body-file is stored as the literal comment body while the intended content is silently discarded and the command exits 0.
A second stacked defect drops any surplus positional value via an args[:min_args] slice, so rebar comment <id> <flag> <value> loses the body twice and still exits 0.
The failure is undetectable because a comment does appear (passing len(comments) checks) with no stderr and exit 0, and the loss is only found later by readers like the completion verifier.

A guard rejects a body argument beginning with '-' with a non-zero exit and a message naming the correct form, covering comment, tag, untag, archive, and set-verify-commands via a command table of arities and Usage lines.
-- is provided and tested as the escape hatch for bodies that legitimately begin with a dash.
The decision was made NOT to add a real --body-file option, documenting the shell-substitution idiom instead; the ticket had asked for an explicit decision either way.
